inspected_pages.observations: Table default: VIN=VREF+0.5V, EN=VIN, CL=10uF, CIN=0.1uF, IL=0. Active IQ maximum 2.6uA for -40 to125C; EN current maximum 0.1uA with VEN=VIN. No-load supply and EN current require separate ownership from output load. Conditions must accompany any budget entry.

Table default: TA25C, RL10k to VS/2, VCM=VOUT=VS/2. IQ per amplifier: 25uA maximum at IO0; 28uA maximum -40 to125C. Four channels give a112uA table-current sum, separate from output currents. Input bias: +/-200pA maximum at25C; +/-150pA over temperature is typical only. Output swing70mV maximum at RL10k over temperature is not blanket startup/fault acceptance.

notes: Existing primary PDFs match revisions of official TI sources opened during this review.
